cards.name: 摄影明信片
cards.prompt:
Use case: graphic-design product mockup.
Make ONE complete front-facing vertical collectible cat card design. A finished flat 2D card filling the image. Target size 1024x2048, narrow tall approximately 1:2 ratio. No surrounding board, perspective, hands or software interface.
Primary request: a completely fresh, simple, content-first card with professional editorial typography. Sophisticated modern graphic design. Use only a photo, a little metadata, a name, a short story and clearly organized scores.
Subject photograph: a lovable real adult calico cat with white chest and front paws, orange and black patches, amber eyes, sitting on warm stone pavement outside a small old cafe. Beautiful soft afternoon sunlight, natural fur, quiet mood. Cat is clearly the focal point, ears and front paws fully visible. Supporting cafe background softly recedes.
Render these exact words and numbers, no extra labels:
"C"
"No. MK-260903-000013"
"桃桃晒太阳"
"午后的阳光刚刚好，"
"遇见一只安静的猫。"
"MIKA" with a total score of "100".
Three separate attributes, each present once: "魅力 100", "机灵 100", "灵气 100". A small thin cat-face, eye and crescent icon respectively accompanies them.
C is the rarity, and MIKA is a separate total score. All four scores must appear. Chinese name and story left aligned. Avoid text collisions, clipped letters, fake text or missing content. Real crisp Chinese typography with clear hierarchy. Give the number consistent inner spacing.
No ornate frames, bevels, gold trim, multiple outlines, flower flourishes, giant badges, rings around scores, ghost cat silhouette, app chrome, gratuitous boxes, heavy gradients, useless empty spaces or dark score panels.
Design direction: PHOTOGRAPHIC POSTCARD.
Warm white paper, small sage-green C square, near-black olive text.
Compact metadata row at the top with C left and number right, aligned on one baseline and shared margins. Beneath this, a big photograph with extremely restrained corner radius, no outline, occupying approximately 68% of card height and 92% of width.
Compact white caption area under photo: large elegant sans-serif Chinese name on the left, typography-only MIKA and 100 on the right. Small two-line story directly beneath the name. Strong but comfortable left alignment.
Bottom row: the 3 thin icons, attribute labels and values arranged horizontally with equal spacing, no boxes or separators. Thoughtfully balanced whitespace. The key character is a quiet refined photographic postcard, excellent proportion and typography.
